meta.title: Famling · Tinglan / Ragdoll / Golden Retriever
meta.description: Shows a pixel mini pet (Tinglan, Ragdoll cat, Golden Retriever) below the DSH account area with no permanent buttons besides the character; right-click the pet (or press Shift+F10 / ContextMenu) to open a restrained hierarchical menu (chat / play / content & characters / settings / more), with submenu pages and full keyboard navigation. A role IS its theme bundle, so the content center is organized as Roles / Customize / Packs / Market; a unified settings popup centralizes every adjustable item and can enable an optional menu button (off by default). Content packs use the reserved v3 pure-data contract with a mandatory research-only declaration; no network, no script execution. Chat text goes through the DSH Host to the model provider configured in DSH (disclosed in the chat panel and settings; never send passwords, private data or client material); crisis keywords are short-circuited locally in the Host with 12356/110/120 and professional-service resources, and settings can turn AI chat off and clear all local settings/consent (withdrawal). Four-level scaling (0.10.4): Common has an overall scale (everything together), independent UI + text / image axes can decouple and follow the overall scale again in one click, and the folded advanced group has per-component scaling that inherits UI + text by default. It only writes this widget's inline styles, never the DSH global theme; persisted under dsh-famling/scale with a one-time migration of the legacy absolute multipliers, the bubble is capped at 240px, menus/panels are fitted to the viewport after scaling, and native range inputs stay keyboard operable. 0.10.6 low disturbance: a new Low disturbance settings group with quiet hours (on by default 22:00-08:00; automatic bubbles and random micro actions are 0 while taps and chat replies still answer; editable or off), an animation preference (follow the system prefers-reduced-motion / allow / reduce motion, with the legacy motion boolean migrated), and temporary hide (1 hour / until tomorrow, persisted in dsh-famling/hidden-until with a single Show restore control and automatic restore); automatic micro actions are now >=60s apart; the input/consent/usage dialogs moved to the lazy client.content.js chunk while the first-screen budget stays within 96 KiB. 0.10.10 versioned consent: TTS/ASR consent is stored as per-kind declaration version, zh+en declaration SHA-256, acceptedAt and withdrawn; a version/hash mismatch re-prompts, the legacy boolean v1 is migrated to withdrawn records, and settings can withdraw it separately. 0.10.11 cross-repo sync: the cat is now a same-palette blue-bicolor Ragdoll (16 palette hexes unchanged, palette id cat-ragdoll-anim@0.1, white silky long coat with cool blue-grey points); cat UI copy is unified as Ragdoll, the wash line now reads long hair, the cat/dog renderer labels are synced, and the cat animation chunk is re-embedded. 0.10.12 host-adaptive appearance: the cat/dog default backgrounds are now transparent (bubble/panel themes stay), the right-click menu no longer uses role-theme hard-coded colours and instead reads DSH host theme variables with light-dark() fallbacks that follow day/night, the buttonBase fallbacks match day/night, and the widget root inherits the host color-scheme.
